subject: Request: Special pricing & packaging for ZenMedAI (VPC + committed capacity)
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: emily@zenmedai.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: committed VPC package + pilot pricing

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call, attached is a two‑tier proposal for ZenMedAI's inpatient triage pilot running on a private VPC:

- 6 month pilot: 40k tokens/day MVL, 1 dedicated instance (T4 equivalent), SOC2 evidence shared
- Host + infra fee: $9,500/month (includes encryption at rest and basic audit logs)
- Usage: $0.0009 per token on top of host fee; 15% discount applied for pilot

I've attached a quick pricing matrix and the standard MOP. If you can confirm the expected 6‑month commit and the pilot start date, I'll open this for internal pricing review.

Next steps I propose:
- ZenMedAI confirms commit window and 6‑month minimum
- Redwood signs an NDA addendum (they requested additional data handling notes)
- I route the special packaging/discount for VP/CFO clearance if required

Would you be available for a 30‑minute follow up on Wednesday to lock dates?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0122

Attachments: zenmedai_pricing_matrix_20270524.xlsx
From: Emily Zhang <emily@zenmedai.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: committed VPC package + pilot pricing

Laura —

Thanks for the proposal. Overall this looks good, but two asks from our side before we can sign a 6‑month commit:

1) Can you do a steeper pilot discount? We're a startup with a constrained budget — looking for 30% off list usage for the pilot (size ~40k tokens/day).
2) We need stronger audit logs and the option to keep raw telemetry for 90 days (we have a clinical audit requirement).

If Redwood can support the pricing and the 90‑day telemetry retention (or a negotiated compromise), we can get approval from our procurement and aim to start the pilot by June 7.

Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Data & Integrations | ZenMedAI
emily@zenmedai.com | +1 (312) 555‑0789
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ZenMedAI asks for 30% pilot discount + 90d telemetry — request for pricing exception

Marissa / Vivek —

Summary: ZenMedAI (prospect) is asking for a 30% usage discount on a 6‑month committed pilot (est. 40k tokens/day) and 90 day raw telemetry retention. They want to start June 7 if we can accommodate. Attached is the pricing matrix they reviewed.

Why this matters:
- High strategic value: deep clinical integration (potential enterprise contract after pilot, estimated $450k ARR if conversion).
- Sales motion: PLG → SLED & enterprise; having a reference in healthcare vertical reduces friction for other deals.
- Risk: increased storage & compliance overhead for 90d telemetry — likely additional infra costs but manageable with retention TTL and encryption.

Recommended exception:
- Approve a 25% usage discount for the 6‑month pilot (instead of 30%) conditional on: 1) a signed 6‑month commitment; 2) a non‑cancellable minimum monthly spend of $7,500; 3) ZenMedAI accepts a telemetry T&Cs addendum with clearly defined retention and deletion schedule.
- Infrastructure: enable telemetry export to customer's S3 (preferred) or retention on Redwood with 90d TTL billed at $300/month to cover storage overhead.

Request: please review and provide VP/CFO clearance to move forward with the above exception. I've flagged this because Emily explicitly asked for a 30% pilot rate and the retention ask increases cost exposure.

Attachments: pricing_exception_memo_laura_20270528.pdf

Thanks,
Laura
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ZenMedAI asks for 30% pilot discount + 90d telemetry — request for pricing exception

Laura —

Thanks for the concise memo and the rationale. I approve the exception with the following edits to the recommended terms:

1) Pilot discount: approve up to 27% off list usage for the 6‑month pilot (compromise between 25/30).
2) Minimum monthly: set the non‑cancellable monthly minimum at $8,000 to protect economics.
3) Telemetry retention: prefer customer‑managed S3 export; if they require us to host telemetry for 90 days, add a $350/month telemetry surcharge.
4) Add a clause: if ZenMedAI does not convert to a committed annual contract within 60 days of pilot end, we reserve the right to retroactively bill to list rates for months beyond the first three pilot months.

Please have Stephanie model the expected margin impact and confirm the $350/month surcharge covers storage + ops overhead. If the numbers look ok, consider this cleared for signature — no CFO signoff required unless the finance model shows negative margin.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ZenMedAI asks for 30% pilot discount + 90d telemetry — request for pricing exception

Team —

I ran the numbers on the proposed terms (27% discount, $8k min monthly, $350/month telemetry surcharge). Conservative assumptions: 40k tokens/day, 30% utilization of committed token cap. Outcome: pilot margin is ~18% on direct cost (GPU + network + storage).

Comments / ask:
- 18% is thin but acceptable for a strategic reference in healthcare if legal signs the telemetry addendum.
- Suggest adding a small clause to the MOP: telemetry surcharge will be invoiced monthly and will be subject to review after pilot month 3.

Conclusion: finance supports Marissa's edits. This does not require formal CFO signature at this stage — we can proceed with the 27% discount + $8k min + $350 telemetry surcharge and route the final SOW to ZenMedAI for signature.

I'll update the pricing_exception_memo with the final economics and copy the invoice language.

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Financial Planning & Analysis | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (internal) pricing_exception_memo_laura_20270528.pdf
